title.zh: 聚焦：抢前台要抢得到，还原要经过同意
title.en: Focus: win the foreground, and restore only with consent

intent.zh: 真机暴露的两个问题：① `focus` 在别的窗口占着前台时永远失败（实测三次温和 SetForegroundWindow 全败，退出码 5，前台是 zerolaunch-rs）——Windows 前台锁拒绝不持有前台的调用者；② 流程格式里根本没有"允许还原最小化窗口"的表达（只有 CLI 有 `--allow-restore`），所以从编辑器跑一个目标最小化的流程必然失败。修法：调用前 AttachThreadInput 接上前台线程的输入队列（不注入按键）并回读真实前台窗口验证；文档加 `allowRestore`，且这份同意要**跟着编译出的命令行**走（步骤由同一个命令行解析器执行，这里有坑：只在运行器里设标志仍然退出码 4）。顺带：编辑器 F5 = 播放，失败信息点名当前前台并提示 UIPI/提权。
intent.en: Two problems the real machine exposed: 1) focus always failed while another window held the foreground (three gentle SetForegroundWindow attempts, exit 5, foreground was zerolaunch-rs) - Windows refuses the call from a caller that does not own the foreground; 2) the flow format had no way to say "you may restore a minimized window" (only the CLI had --allow-restore), so a flow started from the editor against a minimized target could only fail. The fix: attach our input queue to the foreground thread before the call (no keys injected) and verify by reading the real foreground window back; the document gained allowRestore, and that consent must travel with the compiled command line. Also: F5 plays in the editor, and the failure message names the current foreground and mentions UIPI/elevation.

acceptance: 实测：别的窗口占着前台时，focus 仍能成功（AttachThreadInput），并且是回读真实前台窗口后才报成功
实测：最小化目标 + 流程未声明允许 → 退出码 4 且信息里给出如何允许；声明 allowRestore → 还原+聚焦+点击成功
流程文件里的同意必须跟着编译出的命令行走（否则退出码 4）
编辑器 F5 播放；CLI 带上流程文件直接打开
focus 冒烟模块 7 项全过；单元与全量冒烟全绿
note: 聚焦修复落地：AttachThreadInput + 回读前台；流程 allowRestore 与命令行同步；F5 播放；focus 冒烟模块。
